# Colour filter cases shared by Wind (Windows) and Wind for Mac. Read by tests/test_shared_fixtures.cpp
# (src/color/color_matrix.h) and by mac/Tests/WindCoreChecks/SharedFixtures.swift
# (mac/Sources/WindCore/ColorMath.swift).
#
# One case per line: <function> <platform> <inputs...> =<expected> ...
#   platform: all (both run it), win (Windows only), mac (Mac only).
#   Expected values are the tokens that start with '='. Numbers match within 1e-6 (absolute).
#   Warmth is 0..1 (the slider's percent / 100), brightness (dim) 0..1 with 1 = no dimming.
# all and win rows come from the C++ code (Windows is the origin): after an intended change there,
#   set WIND_UPDATE_FIXTURES=1 && build.bat test
# rewrites them, then the Mac must match.
#
#   kelvin K         =r =g =b   blackbody gains in LINEAR light, 6500 K white (KelvinGainsLinear / kelvinGainsLinear)
#   warmk  warm      =K         the Kelvin a warmth maps to (WarmKelvin / warmKelvin): 0..0.5 is 6500 K -> 1200 K
#   warm   warm      =r =g =b   warmth gains in LINEAR light (WarmGainsLinear / warmGainsLinear); past 0.5 the
#                               last green fades out evenly in sRGB terms, so 1 is pure red
#   gains  warm dim  =r =g =b   each channel's scale on sRGB-ENCODED values, saturation 100%: the SDR colour
#                               matrix's diagonal (BuildColorMatrix(warm, dim, false)) on Windows, the display
#                               transfer formula's max per channel (warmGainsSrgb) on the Mac
